chapter_title: Export Oriented Units (EOUs), Electronics Hardware Technology Parks (EHTPs), Software Technology Parks (STPs) and Bio-Technology
title: Leasing of Capital Goods
text: 6.09 Leasing of Capital Goods Value of imported capital goods financed through leasing companies or obtained free of cost and / or on loan / lease basis, shall also be taken into account for purpose of calculation of NFE as defined in FTP.
intent: Support Leasing of Capital Goods processing and compliance validation.
